newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 4.87 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 4.87 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 182-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 4.87 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with the six-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate of 5.70455 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 4.69 percent at the previous tender on February 11.
Bids for the HK$1 billion issue eased to HK$3.50 billion from HK$5.61 billion at the last tender.
The average accepted yield of 91-day Exchange Fund bills was 4.77 percent at another tender on Tuesday, the HKMA said.
This compared with three-month HIBOR of 5.59091 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 4.78 percent at the last weekly tender of quarterly bills.
Bids for the HK$2 billion issue rose to HK$6.37 billion from HK$4.63 billion at the previous tender, the HKMA said.
The average accepted yield for 28-day bills was 4.76 percent compared to one-month HIBOR at 5.46591 percent and the average accepted yield of 4.83 percent at the last tender.
Bids for the HK$5.0 billion issue were HK$10.98 billion compared to HK$10.23 billion on February 18.
